## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `gcloud-pubsub-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a Google Cloud project

1. <!-- manual: Go to the [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/). -->
2. Select the project drop-down and select **New Project**.
3. Enter a project name and select **Create**.
4. <!-- manual: Enter a project name and select Create. -->
5. Note your **project ID** — you will need it for configuration.

## Step 3: Enable the Pub/Sub API

1. <!-- manual: In the Google Cloud Console, navigate to APIs & Services › Library. -->
2. <!-- manual: Search for Cloud Pub/Sub API and select it. -->
3. Select **Enable**.

## Step 4: Create a service account and download the key

1. Navigate to **IAM & Admin** > **Service Accounts** and select **Create Service Account**.
2. Enter a name (for example, `pubsub-connector`).
3. Select **Create and Continue**.
4. <!-- manual: Enter a name (for example, pubsub-connector) and select Create and Continue. -->
5. <!-- manual: Assign the Pub/Sub Editor role (or assign Pub/Sub Publisher and Pub/Sub Subscriber separately for least-privilege access). -->
6. Select **Done**.
7. <!-- manual: Select the newly created service account, then go to the Keys tab. -->
8. Select **Add Key** > **Create new key** > **JSON** > **Create**.
9. <!-- manual: Save the downloaded JSON key file securely — you will need the path to this file for authentication. -->

## Step 5: Create a topic

1. Navigate to **Pub/Sub** > **Topics** and select **Create Topic**.
2. Enter a **Topic ID** (for example, `my-topic`).
3. <!-- manual: Enter a Topic ID (for example, my-topic). -->
4. Select **Create**.

## Step 6: Create a subscription

1. Navigate to **Pub/Sub** > **Subscriptions** and select **Create Subscription**.
2. Enter a **Subscription ID** (for example, `my-subscription`).
3. <!-- manual: Enter a Subscription ID (for example, my-subscription). -->
4. <!-- manual: Select the topic you created in the previous step from the drop-down. -->
5. Set **the delivery type** to **Pull**.
6. Select **Create**.
